annotations.title: Who holds a property or title

description:
Who holds a property or a title on the HM Land Registry company and overseas-entity registers (CCOD/OCOD): for each
    title, the owner class, the company name and company number if it is a company or overseas entity, the tenure and
    the date registered. Give exactly one of `uprn` or `title` (an HMLR title number such as 'EGL123456'); free text
    and names are refused (use resolve_place for an address).

    COST: this tool is charged PER TITLE returned, not per call. A title costs the price below; `limit` is how many
    titles to read and pay for (default 3 titles, at most 10 and only when you ask for it).
    The number of titles available for a UPRN is returned free in `basis.n` and `data.titles_available` on the first
    page: look at it before asking for more, and use `next_cursor` for the rest. A title that fails or has no row is
    not charged; a call with covered=false is not charged.

    Use it for "who owns this" when the owner may be a company. Do NOT read a missing row as "no owner": the registers
    cover England and Wales companies and overseas entities only, and company titles link to a UPRN about 65% of the
    time, so say so. A title held by an individual comes back as owner_class "individual" with no name: say it is held
    by an individual and stop; never try to find the person. Do NOT use it for directors or people, for a
    valuation, or for a company's whole portfolio (use company_portfolio). If `identity` is not `unit` the UPRN may
    name a block, so ask which flat.
    Costs 15 credits (15p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
